source.title: Platincasino offline | #casinosecrets
source.note: Short update by the Casino Secrets publisher. Summaries paraphrase the video; they are claims by the video, not findings of this project.

mentions.claim: Platin Casino is offline for new players; the video says its owner, Thomas Daniel Kalman, has been in custody in Frankfurt since early September over tax evasion of several hundred million euros.
mentions.note: Automatic captions spell the name "Keilmann"; press coverage spells it Kalman.

mentions.claim: About two weeks before publication, a raid in Frankfurt secured around EUR 80 million in assets; the register data showed who owns Platin Casino and allowed an estimate of the tax loss.
